contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Magnentius or Decentius, cut down to remove legend, possibly Amiens mint, Two Victories issue of 350-353, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bare headed bust draped right. Reverse description: Two Victories holding up shield inscribed VOT/V/MVLT[/X]. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]. In exergue: possibly A[--]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight:…
